verification_scope: single-node API smoke; not accuracy or full feature coverage

scenarios.serve_cmd:
export VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE=True
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=0
export CPU_AFFINITY_CONF=1
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

vllm serve /root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR-VL \
    --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.80 \
    --served-model-name PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR-VL PaddleOCR-VL-0.9B \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --no-enable-prefix-caching \
    --mm-processor-cache-gb 0 \
    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' \
    --additional-config '{"enable_cpu_binding":true}' \
    --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
